book.title: The C Programming Language
book.basis: Chapter and exercise references checked against the uploaded PDF. The book itself is not published with Forge.
book.modernC: Use C17 declarations, int main(void), checked bounded input and explicit ownership. The book predates C17; Chapter 8 is UNIX-specific. Avoid gets, implicit function declarations and assumptions about integer widths.
